description: As cfd_2d_bedshear_s16_7 with S 16 1 and the initial bed S 57 0.005 exactly at a cell-centre height (topo = 0 in the cell centres of the bed cells). Before the solid forcing fix these cells were forced to zero velocity (phi <= 0) but counted as fluid by DF/flagsf (topo < 0 solid): the wall law went to the forced cell and the flow was strongly retarded (tau_b 0.04 of rho g S h).
covers: sediment ini with topo = 0 at cell centres
